contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: tab label + rich-text panel content

suitableFor: adventure detail pages (Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring)
any page needing a tabbed content switcher for rich-text panels

repoConventions.note: This repo uses plain block names (cards/columns/hero/carousel) with no variant suffixes. tabs follows the same convention. JS imports only toClassName from the vendored scripts/aem.js (confirmed exported); no fetchPlaceholders import (this repo's aem.js does not export it).
